families.outcome: Interpret cardiovascular health data without reading a correlation as a cause

variants.variation: describe the direction of the relationship across all four rows

variants.variation: choose the further evidence that would actually separate the two explanations

variants.variation: judge a general claim as always / sometimes / never true
